# Task Report: rv64-npc-systemd-path-700m

- status: PASS
- profile: rv64-linux
- task_slug: rv64-npc-systemd-path-700m
- date: 2026-06-12

## Summary

Continued the NPC RV64 Ubuntu systemd bring-up past the previous 260M-cycle probe. A 700M-cycle `check-npc-systemd-guest` probe exposed a real gate harness bug: relative `LOG_DIR` values made the guest command file and `make -C Linux` runtime logs resolve under different directories.

The harness now normalizes `LOG_DIR`, `CONSOLE_LOG`, `NPC_LOG`, and `GUEST_CMDS` to absolute paths before invoking `make -C Linux`.

## Evidence

- Corrected path negative smoke: `Linux/env/logs/codex-npc-systemd-path-negative/console.log`
- 700M probe console summary was captured during the run; the misplaced `Linux/Linux/env/...` log directory was removed after the relative-path bug was identified, because it was generated by the bug itself.

## 700M Probe Result

The run still did not reach `root@ysyx-ubuntu2204:~#`, but it also did not show panic/Oops/Bad trap. It reached real systemd userspace and stopped at max cycles in user mode around `pc=0x0000003f8ebfea28`.

Machine-code lookup against the rootfs ELF set matches the final hot path to glibc/ld.so-style `strncmp` code, not an illegal instruction or trap. This suggests systemd is still executing dynamic userspace work after the banner rather than being stopped by an immediate RTL exception.

## Fix

- `Linux/scripts/check-npc-systemd-guest.sh` now converts relative path inputs to absolute paths.
- `scripts/e2e/modules/npc.sh` checks this path normalization in the contract node.

## Validation

- Relative path negative smoke with `NPC_SYSTEMD_CHECK_MAX_CYCLES=1000`: PASS as an expected negative gate. UART RX loaded the guest script bytes and waited for the root prompt.

## Boundary

This is not full Ubuntu completion. The hard gate remains `make check-npc-systemd-guest`, which requires the real NPC run to reach the root prompt, inject the guest script, and emit `__NPC_SYSTEMD_CHECK_DONE__ rc=0`.
